name: Lavaux, Vineyard Terraces
description: Lavaux is a 30-kilometre stretch of steep, stone-walled vineyard terraces on the northern shore of Lake Geneva in Switzerland, running from Chillon Castle toward Lausanne. Monks began shaping these slopes in the 11th century, and today about 830 hectares of vines, mostly Chasselas grapes, face south over the water. Walking between the villages, you look across the lake toward the Alps.
